messages:
priya: Heads-up — docs PR #8423 introduced a couple confusing examples in the Error Reference (429 / timeouts / fallback). docs CI shows a broken link and a failing snippet repro. Can someone triage?

alex: I saw the CI alert. Broken link is in docs/error-ref/429.md pointing at sdk/js/retries.md (moved last week). The snippet repro that fails is the streaming+context-trim example.

sam: tagging @marta — you reviewed the PR, did you intentionally change the snippet behavior?

marta: I updated wording but didn't mean to change the code examples. I must've grabbed the older retry header example; sorry. I'll take the link fix.

docs-bot: Build #2049 failed — 1 broken link, 1 snippet test failure (docs/error-ref/429.md: line 78). See: https://ci.internal/redwood-docs/builds/2049

priya: Thanks. We should also make the snippet clearer about our recommended fallback order: 1) local retry/backoff, 2) fall back to smaller context (trim prefixes), 3) graceful degrade to lower-capacity model. Right now the example mixes trimming and retries which confuses readers.

alex: Agreed. Also noticed JS SDK example uses an older header 'x-retry-after' while runtime emits 'x-retry-after-ms' now. That mismatch is why the repro failed in the integration test.

sam: Proposed action list: - marta fixes the broken link - alex updates SDK snippet to use x-retry-after-ms and shows parsing - priya will add a short note about trimming heuristics and a tiny sample command to reproduce 429 + context trim locally. Anyone object?

marta: Fine. I'll push a quick link patch to the PR and add a note in the PR description about the code samples that changed. ETA 30m.

alex: I'll open a small patch branch (docs/sdk-snippet-xretry) with the updated JS snippet. Snippet patch:

```js
// recommended: prefer server-provided ms header
const retryAfterMs = parseInt(response.headers['x-retry-after-ms'] || '0', 10);
if (retryAfterMs > 0) {
  await sleep(retryAfterMs);
} else {
  // fallback jittered backoff
  await sleep(100 + Math.random() * 200);
}
```

alex: I'll also add a comment showing how to trim prefix tokens (pseudo):

```text
# trim from start of prompt until token_count <= window
# keep instructions+most recent turns, drop oldest messages
```

priya: For the local repro I'll add a mini script that hits the hosted endpoint with a long prompt and asserts we get 429, then shows trimming reduces it. Should live in docs/samples/429-repro.md and be linked from the 429 doc.

sam: Small UX ask — can we add a one-line table summarizing cause vs suggested mitigation (e.g., 429: surge -> backoff+retry-after; 429: steady high QPS -> adjust batching/limit/route to dedicated). It helps support triage.

marta: Good idea, I'll add that table in the doc edit.

ci-bot: Link fix merged in PR #8423 (marta). Build triggered: #2050.

priya: Great — alex, can you drop your snippet branch into the PR (or I can patch if you want). If both patches land in the same PR we can avoid churn.

alex: I'll push my branch and create a draft commit referencing #8423. If you prefer to squash, happy for you to merge.

ci-bot: Build #2050 started. Running snippet tests.

ci-bot: Build #2050 failed — snippet test still failing (429 repro). Failing assertion: expected initial request to receive 429 for the long prompt.

priya: Hmm. The repro expects the hosted env to return 429 deterministically which is flaky. I'll change the test to run against a local mock server that emits 429 and 'x-retry-after-ms' so it's stable. That avoids depending on traffic.

sam: Good call. Also, update the docs note to recommend mocking for reproducibility when following the guide — reduces flakiness in tutorials.

marta: I've added the small table and link changes. Leaving the example update to alex + the test to priya.

alex: Pushed docs/sdk-snippet-xretry -> PR #8423. The JS snippet now matches header and has comments about trimming.

ci-bot: Build #2051 triggered.

ci-bot: Build #2051 success — all snippet tests passed.

priya: Awesome. Final checklist before we merge: - confirm wording doesn't imply trimming will always succeed - add note about metric/regression watch (e.g., after deploying trimming suggestion run a QA eval) - squash commits and add changelog line.

marta: I'll do the squash and add the changelog blurb.

sam: I'll bookmark the local repro and add a tiny issue to track an improved example that demonstrates model fallback (lower capacity) next quarter.

priya: Thank you all. I'll merge once marta finishes the squash. Quick postmortem: the break happened because the snippet references changed after a small runtime header rename. We'll add a short docs checklist item: "verify header names in SDK snippets vs runtime".

marta: Done — PR merged. Closing this thread. :tada:
